stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Dean Cooper tops the lot on 27 pts, perched up top like Penrith on the ladder with a month of the season still to run.

stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 10 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: Brendan and Tom have turned the card in for the Shumack household, and nobody is conceding anything.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead with 5 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Blake Royal - great to have Thurgoona GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 6 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 3 & 4 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 3, 1-pointer on hole 4

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 11, 3-pointer on hole 12 - that's better

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 8 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 6 twos on holes 12-17 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 18-3

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 6 twos in a row on holes 14-1 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 3-7

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 6 & 7 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 11 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: No Points No Problem... Actually Wait
stories.detail: 6 wipes - the course is undefeated today

stories.title: Donating Points to the Course
stories.detail: 4 straight wipes - the course says thank you

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 16, wipe on hole 17 - the course corrects

stories.title: Points: Not Found
stories.detail: 3 wipes, zero 3-pointers from 10 holes - the course hides its rewards well

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 5, 6 & 7

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: The rain gauge tipped 11.6 and the field simply put the head down and kept going.

cushion of 3 over Blackett - the bar has him at even money
3 clear, 6 to play - the great escape is still escapable
the cushion is 5 - more of a coaster really
